fields.meta_description: Build a design agency landing page from a prompt, with case studies, a project inquiry form, and each inquiry sent to the right person.
fields.h1: Build a Design Agency Landing Page That Wins Client Work
fields.hero_description: Build a design agency landing page that shows your case studies and books qualified clients onto a discovery call.
fields.features_heading: What the Page Does With Each Inquiry
fields.features_subheading: Emergent builds every part below from the prompt you write, and changes any of them when you ask for something different.
fields.feature_1:
Case studies built from your project notes

Emergent builds a case study section from the notes you paste for each project: the client's problem and what the studio shipped. Add a project later with one more prompt.
fields.feature_2:
A short form that asks the budget first

The form shows one question per screen, with tap-to-answer choices for the service and the budget range. A prospect on a phone picks a budget before typing an email.
fields.feature_3:
Every inquiry saved in a database you own

Each inquiry becomes a row in a database you own, with the answers and the page that sent the prospect. Sort the rows by budget to see which services bring larger projects.
fields.feature_4:
Synced to the CRM the studio already uses

Connect HubSpot, or any CRM or project tool with an API. New inquiries arrive there with the prospect's answers attached, and nobody copies a budget out of an email.
fields.feature_5:
Alerts for the inquiries worth a fast reply

Pick the inquiries a person should see first, such as a budget above your minimum. The app posts each one to a Slack channel or emails the creative director the answers.
fields.feature_6:
Your own domain, and the code to keep

Custom domains are included in Emergent and use credits. On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository, where a developer can extend the studio's page.

fields.tab_content_1:
Budgets of $15,000 and up book a discovery call

Tillwright Studio asks each prospect for a budget up front. Imara Solenne asked for a brand identity for Linnet Bakery with a $25,000 budget. Because that clears the studio's $15,000 minimum, the page offered a 30-minute discovery call with creative director Ignatius Wynter. Her answers saved as an inquiry.
fields.tab_content_2:
Readers of one case study sent 9 inquiries in a month

Quarry Pine Studio writes one page per case study, each ending with a Start a similar project button. On the Bramhall Cycles site rebuild page, that button tags every inquiry it sends, and in October it sent 9. Each row in the inquiries table names the case study the prospect came from.
fields.tab_content_3:
When November's 4 sprint slots fill, a waitlist opens

Lumen Fold Design runs a 5-day design sprint and takes 4 clients a month. Each booking fills one slot on the page. Once all 4 November slots were booked, the page swapped the booking button for a December waitlist, and 6 founders have joined it. Each name is saved with the month that founder asked for.
fields.tab_content_4:
Oakhurst Dental accepts its proposal on the page

A prospect at Oakhurst Dental opens a private pitch page from Marlow Ives Creative. It lists a $6,400 brand refresh and a $12,000 website, $18,400 in all. Vera Drayton clicked Accept proposal, and the page saved her name and the date, then posted the acceptance to the #new-business Slack channel.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Design Agency Landing Page
fields.howto_description: These 7 steps take a design agency landing page from one kind of client to a published page that screens inquiries.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Pick the client you want more of
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Choose projects that sell that work
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Describe the page in a prompt
fields.howto_step_1_des: Choose one kind of client for the page, such as funded startups that need a brand identity. A restaurant owner asking for a menu redesign reads a page differently. Write the headline for that one client and name the work you want more of.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Pick case studies that match the client on the page, not your best-known work. For each one, write down the client's problem and the result you can show. Get the client's written OK before the page names them.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Decide the smallest project the studio takes and add it to the form as the lowest budget choice. Inquiries at or above it can book a call. Below it, link a fixed-price starter package instead of a call.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Paste the case studies and the form questions into one prompt for Emergent, with the kind of client in the first line. It returns a working page with the inquiry form and the table behind it. Ask for the confirmation screen in the same prompt.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Route inquiries by service or by budget: brand work to the creative director, site builds to the web lead. Then choose which inquiries post to a Slack channel and which go to one person by email.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Keep motion away from the form
fields.howto_step_6_des: Animate the case study images, never the form. Ask for the page to respect prefers-reduced-motion, a CSS media feature that detects when someone has set their device to minimize non-essential motion.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Send a test inquiry, then publish
fields.howto_step_7_des: Send a test inquiry from your phone and follow it through: the row in the inquiries table, the Slack post, the calendar booking, and the CRM record. Publish once each one works.

faq_plan.q: What is a design agency landing page?
faq_plan.a: A design agency landing page is a single page that sells one studio service to one kind of client and ends in a project inquiry. Unlike the studio's full site, it leaves out the team bios and the blog. It shows the work that proves the offer, then asks for a budget and a start date.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a design agency landing page?
faq_plan.a: Start with the client you want and the smallest budget you accept, then pick two or three case studies that fit that client. Describe all of it to Emergent's AI landing page builder, which builds the page and the inquiry form from that prompt. Send yourself one inquiry before the page goes live.

faq_plan.q: What does a marketing agency landing page show that a design studio page does not?
faq_plan.a: A marketing agency landing page leads with numbers a client can check, such as cost per lead or revenue from a campaign. A design studio page leads with the work itself. If you sell both, put one measured result next to each case study and name the channel that produced it.

faq_plan.q: Should a digital marketing agency landing page show campaign pages it built for clients?
faq_plan.a: Yes, if the client agrees to be named. A digital marketing agency landing page earns trust with real campaign pages, such as a black friday landing page built for a retailer. Show each one with the dates it ran and the result it reached. Get written permission before you show a client's numbers.

faq_plan.q: How many projects should a web design agency landing page show?
faq_plan.a: Show four to six, all for clients like the one the page is written for. A web design agency landing page with 20 thumbnails makes a prospect hunt for the relevant one. Give each project one line on the problem it solved and a link to its full case study.

faq_plan.q: Should a design agency list its prices on its landing page?
faq_plan.a: List a starting price or a minimum budget, even if you never publish a full rate card. A line saying brand identity projects start at $12,000 lets a prospect below that number move on before filling in the form. Emergent builds the budget question as tap-to-answer choices, and each answer saves to a database you own.

faq_plan.q: How can a design agency landing page track which referral partner sent a client?
faq_plan.a: Give each partner its own link with a source tag, and have the form save that tag with every inquiry. Count the inquiries per tag each month, and thank the partners whose tags lead to signed projects. If partners earn a commission on each sale, an affiliate landing page is the better fit.

faq_plan.q: What questions should the inquiry form on a design agency landing page ask?
faq_plan.a: Ask for the service, the budget range, the launch date, and a link to the prospect's current site, with contact details last. Keep it to six questions or fewer; everything else belongs on the discovery call. Emergent can build the form as a conversational flow, one question per screen.

faq_plan.q: Can a design agency landing page book discovery calls directly?
faq_plan.a: Yes. After an inquiry passes your budget rule, the page can show open call times from the calendar of the person who handles that service. Apps built on Emergent connect to any tool with an API, and the booking lands in the calendar the studio already uses.

faq_plan.q: How much animation should a design agency landing page use?
faq_plan.a: Use enough to show your craft on the case studies, and none on the form or the main button. web.dev recommends you restrict animations to opacity and transform to keep animations on the compositing stage of the rendering path. If motion is the thing you sell, build an animated landing page for it instead.

plan.angle: Searchers for a design agency landing page (and the marketing agency, digital marketing agency and web design agency variants) want to know what the page should carry and a fast way to publish one. Template galleries stop at the layout. This page shows four agency pages built from a prompt and follows each inquiry to where it lands: a project inquiry that clears a $15,000 minimum and books a discovery call, a case study whose button tags every inquiry it sends, a design sprint page that opens a waitlist when its 4 monthly slots fill, and a private pitch page where a prospect accepts the proposal. The FAQ covers the definition, how a marketing agency page differs, how many projects to show, pricing on the page, referral tracking, inquiry questions, booking calls and motion. SEO agency and consulting pages are siblings and stay out.

Quarry Pine Studio publishes one page per case study, and the Bramhall Cycles site rebuild page tags every inquiry from its Start a similar project button, which counted 9 inquiries this month.
Lumen Fold Design sells a 5-day design sprint with 4 slots a month, and once all 4 November slots are booked the page swaps the booking button for a December waitlist that 6 founders have joined.

Marlow Ives Creative sends Oakhurst Dental a private pitch page with a $6,400 brand refresh and a $12,000 website, and when Vera Drayton accepts the $18,400 proposal the page saves her acceptance and posts it to the #new-business Slack channel.

scope.evidence: H1 'Build a Design Agency Landing Page That Wins Client Work'; hero 'Build a design agency landing page that shows your case studies and books qualified clients onto a discovery call.' (under 130 chars, leads with Build); how-to description one sentence: 'These 7 steps take a design agency landing page from one kind of client to a published page that screens inquiries.'

intent.evidence: Informational searcher gets four worked examples (Project Inquiries, Case Studies, Design Sprints, Pitch Pages), a 7-step how-to specific to studios ('Set a minimum budget', 'Choose projects that sell that work'), a definition in FAQ 1 and a comparison table; absorbed agency-landing-page secondaries all covered in FAQ 3-5.

specificity.evidence: Studio vocabulary throughout: 'discovery call', 'creative director', 'brand identity', 'Start a similar project', '5-day design sprint', 'private pitch page'; table cells match rules/competitors/lp.json verbatim for Unbounce, Landingi, Wix and the Emergent column.

openers.evidence: Every paragraph opens on a full sentence with an actor: 'Tillwright Studio asks each prospect for a budget up front.', 'Quarry Pine Studio writes one page per case study', 'Emergent builds a case study section from the notes you paste'.

craft.evidence: No tacked-on endings or run-on lists; sentences vary ('Publish once each one works.' vs longer routing sentences). Minor items recorded as notes.

voice.evidence: Concrete, unglamorous detail: '$6,400 brand refresh and a $12,000 website, $18,400 in all', '6 founders have joined it', 'nobody copies a budget out of an email'. No hype verbs.

truth.evidence: MDN quote matches step 06 ('a CSS media feature that detects when someone has set their device to minimize non-essential motion'); web.dev quote matches FAQ 10; table cells equal library text (checked 2026-09-28, within 180 days); Emergent claims map to claims_used (code-export 'on paid plans', custom-domain 'included ... use credits', conversational, database-owned, api-connect, alerts); $6,400 + $12,000 = $18,400 in copy and image.

distinct.evidence: No use of portfolio, freelancer, consulting, coaching or SEO agency primaries; agency landing page was merged into this page (plan/overrides.json). Tab stories (budget gate, case-study tag, sprint waitlist, pitch acceptance) are studio-specific.
